description: Composite company-info brief v1: runs REDUCE-5 opendata steps (nts.status, nts.validate, g2b.sanction, kiscon.sanction, env.waste_sanction), then builds a computed brief. No account_link_id and no certificate are needed: every step runs on our platform key. Empty sanction matches must not be treated as proven clean. If computed is null the result could not be assembled: read computed_error for the reason and do not present the result as complete. Two shapes carry that case: this envelope with partial set to true (we fetched everything - the legs hold it - but could not calculate), or an error whose data carries the same envelope. partial is true whenever the result is incomplete, whether a leg failed or the calculation did. Files: a document generated from this result, as PDF only when requested in output_formats, listed in artifacts[] of the result with a download_url that works for 15 minutes; each file is kept for 7 days. If a link has expired, call xdata__job__result with the pack_run_id from the result for fresh links. For an anonymous result, keep its private recovery_receipt and send it with the original job_id or pack_run_id to xdata__job__result. It grants access to that result only, until the original file retention expires. Do not publish it. Losing it cannot be repaired by signing up. The receipt also works if the client later signs in; it does not grant access to other results. Without a receipt, results require the original account and lane. 호출마다 토큰 4소진 요청 처리 시 XBOSS 작업을 생성하고 처리 결과를 저장합니다. 기관 원본의 조회 여부와 별개로 이 호출은 순수 읽기 전용이 아닙니다. 기관 데이터 변경은 도구별 실행 내용과 기존 확인 절차를 따릅니다.

corp_name.description: Optional corp name fallback for kiscon matching

idempotency_key.description: Optional outer idempotency key; leg keys are derived deterministically from this value.

output_formats.description: Optional. Also return this result as a file (PDF) in artifacts[] of the result. Omit it for data only.
